tagline: 佳能便携相机，1995 年发布
description: 佳能于1995年推出的便携相机。配备35-70mm f/4.2-7.8 zoom retracts fully into the body.。快门速度electronic。感光度Auto DX; 50 to 3200 ISO.。Auto: 3 point AF; 0.6m to inf.。

specs.Camera-wiki: Canon Sure Shot 70 Zoom/Prima Zoom 70F/Autoboy Luna 35
specs.镜头: 35-70mm f/4.2-7.8 zoom retracts fully into the body.
specs.英文简介: An April 1995 model from the Sure Shot series, the Sure Shot 70 Zoom (Euro: Prima Zoom 70F, Japan: Autoboy Luna 35) was a compact camera with fully automatic 3-point autofocus and a zoom lens.
